note: The private half of tests/data/game_menu_mutants.json (tools/mutate.py runs it together with the public half): the mutants of files that are not in the public repository, and the ones that only a test that is not there catches. Mutants of the settings menu for tools/mutate.py (docs/TESTING.md, 'Mutation checks'): the page's script web/game_menu.js against tests/scripts/web_game_menu_check.js (node, on a strict fake of the DOM), and the game's side (src/ants_app/game_menu.cpp, application_game_menu.cpp, the HUD's Esc, the event loop's gate, the mixer's gain) against tests/test_app/test_game_menu.cpp and the mixer's case 4.5b of test_app_integration, the desktop's drawn panel (game_menu_panel.cpp) against test_game_menu, the Quick Chat texts (options_state.cpp) against test_options, Ctrl+O and the Options button (hud_keys.cpp, hud_pointer.cpp) against test_pointer_model, and the corner (Show FPS and Show ping: fps_overlay.hpp, application_net.cpp, latency_corner.cpp) and the score labels' sizes (hud.cpp) against N5.29b and N5.103 of test_network_app and test_hud_layout. Run from the checkout: tools/mutate.py tests/data/game_menu_mutants.json --keep-going --jobs 1; every mutant must be caught. tests/scripts/test_web_game_menu.py runs the script's mutants, the scrolling's and the style's on a copy of the files.
